{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-0y42","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-worker6-243t: TH_2 missing CBOR encoding per RFC 9528 Section 4.1.2","description":"The TH_2 transcript hash computation in edhoc.c uses raw binary concatenation of G_Y || H(message_1) (64 bytes) instead of CBOR-encoded inputs as required by RFC 9528 Section 4.1.2.

RFC 9528 states: "The input to the hash function is a CBOR Sequence."

TH_2 input should be:
- CBOR bstr encode G_Y: 0x5820 || <32 bytes> = 34 bytes
- CBOR bstr encode H(message_1): 0x5820 || <32 bytes> = 34 bytes
- Concatenate and hash the 68-byte sequence

Current code (both initiator at line 720 and responder at line 1161) does:
- Raw concatenation: G_Y || H(message_1) = 64 bytes, then hash

Compare with `compute_th()` at line 72 which correctly uses `zcbor_bstr_encode_ptr` for TH_3 and TH_4 transcript hashes, demonstrating the project already has the right approach for CBOR-encoding transcript hash inputs.

This is a pre-existing issue not introduced by the current fix (which correctly changed the order from H(msg1)||G_Y||C_R to G_Y||H(msg1) and removed C_R), but should be fixed to ensure spec compliance and interoperability.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"agent@lichen-project.dev","created_at":"2026-07-24T19:35:58.631505265Z","created_by":"AI Agent","updated_at":"2026-07-24T19:35:58.631505265Z"}
